tool_arguments.query: PC laptop shipments Q3 2026 global market share by vendor

events.content: PC laptop shipments Q3 2026 global market share by vendor

**Latest reported quarter: Q3 2026 (ended September).** Gartner estimates worldwide PC shipments of **55.35 million units**, down **22.4% year over year** from 71.30 million in Q3 2025. [[1]] 

Gartner’s vendor results place Lenovo first at **14.99 million units** (27.1% share), followed by HP at **10.37 million** (18.7%), Dell at **7.58 million** (13.7%), Apple at **5.84 million** (10.5%), ASUS at **4.68 million** (8.5%), and Acer at **3.87 million** (7.0%). [[1]] 

IDC’s separate preliminary estimate is higher—**62.7 million traditional PCs**, down **20.1% year over year** and **9.1% sequentially**—illustrating that totals vary with each research firm’s shipment definitions and coverage. [[2]] [[3]] 

The reported downturn was attributed chiefly to higher memory and storage costs feeding through to PC prices, alongside inventory stockpiling earlier in the year that pulled demand forward. [[1]] [[4]]
